name: 72301 · West Memphis, AR
findings: ZIP 72301 (West Memphis) has 63 nonprofit organizations. 16 of them (25%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 13 organizations.
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 72301 (West Memphis) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
81% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 72301 (West Memphis) list volunteering in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 33% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 9 organizations here; 81% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find ways to volunteer now, including outside formal organizations?
